posts.topic: .NET 10 JSON Console Logging: Stop Parsing State.Message
posts.opener: Leftover pizza in the fridge, phone at 7 % and the charger is in the other bag. .NET 10 finally stopped echoing the same string inside State.Message when it writes JSON to the console. That extra copy was a tiny nuisance - more null checks, a messier schema, and it showed up in my log-parsers like a stray semicolon.
